items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Yes, he was on the boat too, I remember, the clarinet's parents.

ctx.x: Captain Vern's breakfast, Reel 2, September the 22nd, 1960. All right, so we're talking about people, uh, from across the room. Do you remember, by the way, do you remember Baby Dodge's brother Johnny who played clarinet?
Yes, he was on the boat too, I remember, the clarinet's parents.
